item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appears to retain whichever side contains an intended final card: after the first tap it either keeps the tapped pair or its complement, then either keeps the tapped card or the other card. The observations do not reveal how—or when—the intended card was selected."}
